title: WAPC approval of survey-strata or strata lots for an existing authorised grouped dwelling development below Table 3B
text: The WAPC, in consultation with the local government, may approve the creation of a survey-strata lot or strata lot for an existing authorised grouped dwelling development of a lesser minimum and average site area than that specified in Table 3B, where, in the opinion of the WAPC or the local government, the development on the resulting survey-strata or strata lots is consistent with the objectives of the relevant design elements of the R-Codes, and the orderly and proper planning of the locality.

source.file: Residential Design Codes Chapter 3 - Grouped Dwellings.pdf

notes: diverges: a different provision under the same number. Chapter 3 M4.1.4 (p53) is strata lots for existing authorised grouped development; Chapter 2 M4.1.4 is the corner-lot potential change, which is M4.1.5 here. WAPC discretion, not an applicant test.
